summary: A man has reportedly threatened to carry out a suicide attack against the football star during the tournament.

headline: Lionel Messi's father has passed away
summary: The football legend's father, who played a pivotal role in his journey from Rosario to Barcelona, has died.
details: Lionel Messi's father has passed away, according to reports from Goal.com.
He was a central figure in Messi's early life and career, supporting him through his move from Rosario, Argentina, to Barcelona, Spain.
His presence was a constant shadow and support system for the star athlete throughout his professional journey.
The news has sparked tributes from across the football world as fans and colleagues remember the loss.
